title.official: Explanatory Report to the Council of Europe Framework Convention on Artificial Intelligence and Human Rights, Democracy and the Rule of Law

relevance.reason: The official explanatory report accompanying CETS 225, commenting on the Preamble and Articles 1–36. It facilitates understanding of the Convention but expressly does not provide an authoritative interpretation.
ai_provisions: Commentary on the Preamble and Articles 1–36 of CETS 225
relevance.excluded_scope: Interpretive document, not a source of binding obligations; not an authoritative interpretation.

dates.notes: Dated Vilnius, 5 September 2024; the Convention was adopted by the Committee of Ministers on 17 May 2024.

status_note: Published with the Convention. Non-binding interpretive material.

languages.note: English and French versions; the report itself states it is not an authoritative interpretation.
